import json, copy, work

cases = [
 ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','meta':{'x':1,'y':2}}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'meta':{'y':2,'x':1},'kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),
 ({'declared':['gone','still-gone'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone']}),
 ({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'z':1},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'z':2}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
]
for request, policy, expected in cases:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy))
 got=work.evaluate(request,policy)
 assert got==expected,(got,expected)
 assert request==before[0] and policy==before[1]
 assert set(got)=={'needs_review','changed'}
print('custom checks passed', len(cases))
